candidate_structure.information_flow: The first call receives all common inputs, forms one complete executable policy artifact, and seals the supplied evidence context with indivisible whole-policy authority in one capsule. The final call consumes only that capsule, exercises joint authority over contract-facing and behavior-bearing semantics, establishes end-to-end conformance, and emits one policy.
candidate_structure.name: Sealed-Context Unitary Authority Capsule
candidate_structure.organization: two-call sequential lineage with one authority-bearing executable capsule and no terminal external evidence edges

calls.objective: Form one complete executable policy artifact from the supplied evidence and place it in an authority-bearing capsule without freezing a separate contract-facing boundary.

Consume encapsulate_unitary_authority as the sole evidence source, exercise indivisible authority over the inherited complete artifact, establish its end-to-end public conformance, and emit one complete policy.

mode_certificate.forbidden_inherited_mechanism: immutable public-contract authority boundary on the executable-closure handoff
mode_certificate.independent_replacement_principle: A sealed executable capsule carries all terminally usable evidence and indivisible authority over one complete policy artifact until final emission.
rejected_assumptions: Contract-facing conformance must become immutable before terminal behavioral revision.
Terminal authority requires direct external evidence edges in addition to an executable predecessor.
Contract-facing and behavior-bearing semantics should be governed by separate authorities.

qualitative_hypothesis.causal_change: Replace the contract-locked relay with one authority-bearing executable capsule that becomes the terminal call's sole evidence and preserves indivisible whole-policy revision authority until emission.
qualitative_hypothesis.expected_effect: Joint revision from sealed context will alter scan resistance, phase-shift adaptation, and object-hit versus byte-hit balance by removing the inherited representational boundary while retaining end-to-end conformance responsibility.
qualitative_hypothesis.falsifier: all-valid matched majority and strict-median contract, with no score
qualitative_hypothesis.observed_bottleneck: Freezing contract-facing semantics before terminal behavioral authority prevents coherent revision when conformance structure and behavioral effects are interdependent.

structural_mutation.after: The first authority emits one complete executable policy capsule containing the available evidence context without partitioning contract-facing from behavior-bearing authority; the terminal authority consumes only that capsule and may revise the policy as one indivisible artifact before emission.
structural_mutation.before: A contract-lock authority emits an executable closure with immutable contract-facing semantics, after which a terminal authority receives additional external evidence and may revise only behavior-bearing semantics.
structural_mutation.factor: sealed-context transfer of indivisible whole-policy authority
structural_mutation.why_structural: The authority-bearing capsule makes the predecessor edge the sole terminal evidence edge and defines whole-policy authority as an inseparable property of that edge, changing concrete visibility and authority semantics rather than splitting or renaming roles.

validation.factor: sealed-context transfer of indivisible whole-policy authority

policy_bearing_output_kinds.executor_semantics: complete policy artifact plus obligation evidence on the same single lineage
